run-tests.name: Astronomical landmarks, continuity, and tiny-fragment units
Spatial partition finds neighbors across cell boundaries
Bound objects follow curved orbits instead of radial homing
Bound orbits dissipate energy into eventual absorption
Above-escape-speed objects can leave a gravity well
Massive bodies deflect passing flight trajectories
Absorption conserves mass including shed fragments and mixes momentum
Similar-mass collisions bounce and produce recoverable debris
High-speed impacts shed more mass than slow captures
A stronger rival cannot end a healthy player in one impact
Spawn protection allows safe captures but blocks dangerous impacts
Repeated severe impacts eventually produce game over
Relaxed difficulty reduces damage and fragmentation
AI competitors absorb and evolve without player participation
Cautious AI flees a nearby dominant body
Aggressive AI hunts a weaker player
Upgrade choices require points and apply stacking effects
Boost consumes energy and increases acceleration
Save serialization preserves position, velocity, rivals and upgrades
Repeated checkpoints do not double-count lifetime statistics
Corrupt and non-finite saved bodies are rejected
Procedural streaming maintains resources while travelling
Gravity remains finite at fifteen astronomical stages
Very unequal masses avoid pathological spatial scans
Stable orbit classification distinguishes circular capture and escape
Rival star builds a stable hierarchical planet and moon system
Player can steal a rival world when the new gravity well dominates
Passing massive rival destabilizes the player outer system
Rival black hole strips stored disk matter without instant mass credit
Black-hole inner transfer has a meaningful delay and conserves mass
Extended achievements and lifetime counters are idempotent
A genuine rotating reservoir unlocks the disk achievement
Black-hole merger achievement requires substantial inner assimilation
Surviving a disturbance awards the existing achievement system
Rival hierarchy, disk ownership and new counters survive checkpoint
A destroyed parent safely releases children without a reference error
System adaptations stack in the existing ranked choice list
Fifty unique companion recipes span five disclosed rarities
Asteroid collisions collect water and DNA once, without instant mass credit
Spawned fields carry finite life samples and pooled bodies reset resources
DNA egg recipes deduct exact costs and reject duplicates or insufficient resources
Every named DNA recipe can hatch and equip its exact companion
Companion buffs resolve all five rarity tiers including the new shape passives
Discovery wheel maps the documented 59/35/5/1 odds across ten thousand samples
New lifetime statistics initialise, increment once, and survive a save round trip
System stability bonus is zero after a disturbance and returns after thirty quiet seconds
Companion collection normalization preserves valid discoveries and rejects invalid eggs
Planetary composition conserves weighted fractions and affects density
Moving habitable zones and surface climate use the current stellar source
Measured 2:1 stable orbits earn and lose the resonance bonus

slots-check.name: Version-1 migration preserves run, pets, nicknames, records and settings
Two evolutions, pauses and settings writes do not advance the checkpoint
Third evolution atomically saves world, resource claims, pets and achievements
Three more evolutions are required after a milestone or manual save
Reload rolls back the whole unsaved journey without duplicating resources
Slot toggles preserve three independent journeys and companion collections
Disabling cadence restores timed saves and settings remain global
Game over records the result and clears only the active run
Admin method, menu and keyboard shortcut have been removed
Companion live preview animates and all 50 species render
Size controls persist and do not change buffs; reduced motion freezes creatures
Twenty restarts and slot switches add no RAF loops or event listeners
Failed storage does not falsely advance the last successful checkpoint

life-integration.name: Life Lab works from main menu with all fifty procedurally rendered cards
Craft, active-flight incubation, pause, hatch, equip and unequip
Reload restores companion, egg progress, samples and claimed asteroid together
Repeated restarts retain collection without multiplying listeners or animation loops
Companion scanner reveals samples farther away without creating physics entities

editorial-check.name: Mouse-down updates its target without requiring a prior mousemove
Leaving the playfield stops mouse steering and preserves keyboard thrust
Steering has a small center dead zone and ignores menu clicks
All retained menus have meaningful dialog labels
Adaptations use numbered marks and remain selectable
Saved mute preference has an accurate initial label
All 21 classes render, update menus and retain finite state without runtime logging errors
404 links remain relative offline and resolve from the host root online
Menu and runtime version match the delivered package

expedition-check.name: Galaxy chart survives checkpoint, reload and floating-origin rebasing
Extraction depletes the same sector that drives future galactic matter
Pet evolution requires bond and experience; forks preserve species rarity and buffs
Planet composition changes radius, mixes by mass and resets pooled state
Habitable zone moves with stellar growth and climate reflects atmosphere and flare heat
Physical stable 2:1 orbits acquire a bonus after dwell and lose it when disturbed
Planet and moon retain hierarchical parentage during coasting
Flare is forecast before a physical wave strips atmosphere and perturbs velocity once
Magnetar encounter is an actual compact source and wave state reloads safely
Sandbox grants and deaths never alter normal-slot resources, records or achievements
Replay samples live positions without mutating physics and survives game over
Photo pauses simulation, exports a PNG canvas and restores the exact camera and state
New controls, paused map/replay rendering and all pet branches draw without errors
Replay browsing follows the selected save, not the previous live scene
Companion specializations have distinct procedural silhouettes
Twenty restarts and mode switches add no loops, listeners or accumulated replay frames
New procedural cue names use the existing synthesizer without parallel audio objects
Malformed expedition reservoirs are rejected and new panels have precise accessible labels

merge-check.name: Merged shape passive and permanent evolution apply together
Tabs retain equipped evolution and nickname while hiding other tab sections
Adaptive hash does not enlarge the unequipped life scanner
Both save formats preserve new attachment fields and current expedition state
New sandbox statistics never credit normal journey records
Both source additions remain available across stellar and black-hole rendering
